none: PAS FindID 997226: Lin-785152: Roman nummus of Constantine II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340),Gloria Exercitus, Reece period 17, dating AD 333-334. Heavily worn. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: illegible. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them; standards have triangular tops, wreath between the tops of standards. Reverse inscription: [GLO]RIA EXERCIT]US. Diameter: 14.43 mm; Thickness: 1.48 mm; Weight: 1.55g
